data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's transferred counting formula 'pieces added = intersections + 1' is inapplicable to concurrent diameters: a new diameter intersects all previous diameters at the same center point, yet it splits only 2 existing sectors, not n+1 regions. Thus the uncritically adopted formula contradicts the very concurrency-collapse adaptation the target admits is required, rendering the analogy's core transfer invalid for the stated problem.
